entities.summary: Romania is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Bucharest. Official languages include Romanian. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 19.0 million. Area: 238,397 km². Comprehensive index for Romania covering Dacian kingdom (Decebalus), Roman conquest (Trajan 106 CE, Dacia Traiana), Romance language survival, medieval principalities (Wallachia/Moldavia/Transylvania), Ottoman suzerainty, Russian influence, union 1859, Kingdom 1881, WWI (joined Entente 1916, gained Transylvania/Bessarabia), Greater Romania 1918-40, WWII (Antonescu allied with Axis, switched 1944), communist era (1945-89, Gheorghiu-Dej, Ceaușescu), Revolution 1989 (violent, Ceaușescus executed), EU/NATO 2004/2007.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Romania's union in 1859 and its subsequent Kingdom in 1881 led to significant territorial gains, including Transylvania, which had a lasting impact on regional politics. The country's role in WWII and its switch from the Axis to the Allies in 1944 also contributed to its historical significance.
